inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Suspicious Microsoft Graph API Activity by Application

properties.description: This detection identifies potentially malicious or unauthorized activity performed through the Microsoft Graph API by applications or service principals that are not part of an approved allowlist
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Suspicious Microsoft Graph API Activity by Application
properties.query:
// Allowlist for trusted applications/service principals that are expected to perform these actions. 
let initiatorAllowList = dynamic([
    "Microsoft PIM",
    "Microsoft Entra Connect",
    "Azure AD Connect"
    // Add App IDs or Display Names of trusted applications, such as DevOps or monitoring tools.
]);
// Part 1: Detects adding credentials to an application or service principal.
let credentialAddition = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where Category == "ApplicationManagement"
| where OperationName in ("Update application", "Update service principal", "Add service principal credentials")
| where Result == "Success"
| where isnotempty(InitiatedBy.app)
| where not(tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName) in (initiatorAllowList))
| mv-expand ModifiedProperties = TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties
| where tostring(ModifiedProperties.displayName) has_any ("Credentials", "KeyCredential")
| where isnotempty(tostring(ModifiedProperties.newValue))
| extend TargetApp = TargetResources[0],
         InitiatorIpAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
         InitiatorAppId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.appId),
         InitiatorDisplayName = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
         TargetDisplayName = tostring(TargetResources.displayName),
         TargetId = tostring(TargetResources.id)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by InitiatorAppId, InitiatorDisplayName, TargetDisplayName, TargetId, CorrelationId
| extend Activity = "Credential Added to Application/SP";
// Part 2: Detects adding a new owner to an application or service principal.
let ownerAddition = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where Category == "ApplicationManagement"
| where OperationName has "Add owner to"
| where Result == "Success"
| where isnotempty(InitiatedBy.app)
| where not(tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName) in (initiatorAllowList))
| extend Target = TargetResources[0],
         AddedOwnerInfo = TargetResources.modifiedProperties[0].newValue,
         InitiatorIpAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
         InitiatorAppId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.appId),
         InitiatorDisplayName = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
         TargetDisplayName = tostring(TargetResources.displayName),
         TargetId = tostring(TargetResources.id)
| summarize AddedOwners = make_set(AddedOwnerInfo), arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by InitiatorAppId, InitiatorDisplayName, TargetDisplayName, TargetId, CorrelationId
| extend Activity = "Owner Added to Application/SP";
// Part 3: Detects modification of a Conditional Access policy by an application.
let caPolicyModification = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where OperationName == "Update Conditional Access policy"
| where Result == "Success"
| where isnotempty(InitiatedBy.app)
| where not(tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName) in (initiatorAllowList))
| extend TargetPolicy = TargetResources[0],
         InitiatorIpAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
         InitiatorAppId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.appId),
         InitiatorDisplayName = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
         TargetDisplayName = tostring(TargetResources.displayName),
         TargetId = tostring(TargetResources.id)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by InitiatorAppId, InitiatorDisplayName, TargetDisplayName, TargetId, CorrelationId
| extend Activity = "Conditional Access Policy Modified";
// Union all suspicious activities
union credentialAddition, ownerAddition, caPolicyModification
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated,
         AccountCustomEntity = InitiatorDisplayName,
         IpCustomEntity = InitiatorIpAddress
